scope: Front half of FEATUREFINDER/FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked.h/.cpp: getDefaultParameters, updateMembers_ and the run_ parameter reads, the input checks of run, steps 0 to 3.2 of run_ (intensity quantiles and scores, trace scores and local maxima, isotope-pattern precalculation, pattern scores, overall scores and seed selection), positionScore_, nearest_, findIsotope_, isotopeScore_, both intensityScore_ overloads and getIsotopeDistribution_. method: Port with executed differential tests. The C2 class-level driver ffap_stages and a B6 driver seed_stage run FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked::run in the product SDK and read its protected seed-stage state through a derived probe class. ../oracle/b6-ffap-seeds/extract.py converts their records into TSV fixtures with floats as IEEE-754 bit patterns; tests/feature_finder_picked_seeds.rs rebuilds every configuration with the Rust loaders and compares members, quantiles, isotope windows, all per-peak score arrays and the ordered seed lists bit for bit. oracle.comparison: Exact: every f64 and f32 value bit for bit, every count and index equal, on Linux x86-64 against the macOS arm64 oracle. The single exception is the overall score (source std::pow(float, float), Apple powf in the oracle): 99 of 30,840 executed values are one binary32 step away from the correctly rounded power; overall_rounding.tsv lists them and the test requires the port's value to be the correctly rounded one there and the executed one everywhere else. The port evaluates the power as libm::pow in f64 rounded once to f32, which is platform-independent; libm::powf differed from the oracle on 226 of 3,084 FFC_1 scores. Inputs use only IEEE +, -, *, /, sqrt and comparisons besides that power, so no other libm result enters.
